name: Gym Leader Rush + Shuffle
description: All-in-one sequential Gym Leader Rush with persistent Gym Leader Shuffle mechanics, shuffled gym NPC rosters, visiting-leader party scaling, per-save optional move randomization, EXP scaling, area shops, Gen 1 Victory Road handoff, and the Gen 2 Johto-to-Kanto continuation. Supports only the original Gen 1 and Gen 2 game targets, including Crystal; excluded from FireRed, LeafGreen, and Emerald.
